overview_description.description: Firework offers video commerce solutions built for websites, apps, and stores. They operate a storytelling platform intended to live stream videos directly on the website. The company's platform features in-video shopping, lead generation, and live streaming events and allows importing and editing videos, enabling brands to engage and convert their website visitors.
